Sample (ayah 1)

إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ

Sahih International: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.

Yusuf Ali: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance).
